setting.help: rs.ge credentials are stored per user and per company. Switch to the company, open Settings > Users > Preferences > Revenue Service (rs.ge), fill in the rs.ge Username and Password, then click 'Test RS Credentials' to validate them and store the company's taxpayer id. Tick 'RS Responsible User' on the user whose login runs that company's scheduled actions.
setting.div: Per user and per company: Settings > Users > Preferences > Revenue Service (rs.ge), in each company.
